```{r}
library(shiny)

library(DT)

options(
  shiny.maxRequestSize = 500 * 1024^2
)

```

```{r}
#| context: setup

read_input <- function(path, filename){

    sep <-
        if(grepl("\\.csv$", filename, ignore.case = TRUE))
            ","
        else
            "\t"

    read.table(
        path,
        sep = sep,
        header = TRUE,
        quote = "",
        comment.char = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        check.names = FALSE
    )

}

find_intensity_columns <- function(df, pattern){

    grep(
        pattern,
        names(df),
        value = TRUE
    )

}

build_matrix <- function(df, cols){

    x <- as.matrix(df[, cols, drop = FALSE])

    x[x == 0] <- NA

    storage.mode(x) <- "double"

    x

}

build_metadata <- function(df, intensity_cols){

    df[
        ,
        setdiff(names(df), intensity_cols),
        drop = FALSE
    ]

}

encode_row_names <- function(mat, meta){

    rownames(mat) <-
        apply(
            meta,
            1,
            paste,
            collapse=";_;"
        )

    mat

}

decode_metadata <- function(mat, meta_names){

    meta <-
        as.data.frame(
            do.call(
                rbind,
                strsplit(
                    rownames(mat),
                    ";_;"
                )
            ),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

    names(meta) <- meta_names

    meta

}

```

```{r}
#| context: server

rawData <- reactive({

    req(input$file)

    read_input(
        input$file$datapath,
        input$file$name
    )

})

observe({

    req(rawData())

    cols <-
        find_intensity_columns(
            rawData(),
            input$pattern
        )

    updateSelectInput(
        session,
        "sample",
        choices = cols,
        selected =
            if(length(cols))
                cols[1]
            else
                character(0)
    )

})

vsnData <- eventReactive(input$run,{

    df <- rawData()

    intensity_cols <-
        find_intensity_columns(
            df,
            input$pattern
        )

    validate(
        need(
            length(intensity_cols) > 0,
            "No matching intensity columns found."
        )
    )

    IntVST <-
        build_matrix(
            df,
            intensity_cols
        )

    metaData <-
        build_metadata(
            df,
            intensity_cols
        )

    IntVST <-
        encode_row_names(
            IntVST,
            metaData
        )

    LFQvsn <-
        justvsn(
            IntVST,
            minDataPointsPerStratum = 0
        )

    colnames(LFQvsn) <-
        paste0(
            "vsn_",
            colnames(IntVST)
        )

    pow2LFQvsn <-
        2^LFQvsn

    colnames(pow2LFQvsn) <-
        paste0(
            "pow2_",
            colnames(IntVST)
        )

    recoveredMeta <-
        decode_metadata(
            LFQvsn,
            names(metaData)
        )

    exportTable <-
        cbind(
            recoveredMeta,
            IntVST,
            LFQvsn,
            pow2LFQvsn
        )

    list(

        raw = IntVST,

        meta = recoveredMeta,

        vsn = LFQvsn,

        pow2 = pow2LFQvsn,

        export = exportTable,

        intensity_columns = intensity_cols

    )

})

output$summary <- renderPrint({

    req(rawData())

    df <- rawData()

    intensity_cols <-
        find_intensity_columns(
            df,
            input$pattern
        )

    cat(
        "Rows:",
        nrow(df),
        "\n"
    )

    cat(
        "Columns:",
        ncol(df),
        "\n"
    )

    cat(
        "Intensity columns:",
        length(intensity_cols),
        "\n\n"
    )

    if(length(intensity_cols))
        print(intensity_cols)

})

output$download <- downloadHandler(

    filename=function(){

        paste0(

            tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                input$file$name
            ),

            ".",

            input$pattern,

            ".vsn.txt"

        )

    },

    content=function(file){

        write.table(

            vsnData()$export,

            file=file,

            sep="\t",

            quote=FALSE,

            row.names=FALSE

        )

    }

)

```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$rawbox <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())

    boxplot(
        log2(vsnData()$raw),
        las = 2,
        outline = FALSE,
        main = "Raw log2 Intensities",
        ylab = "log2(Intensity)"
    )

})

output$meansd <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())

    meanSdPlot(
        vsnData()$vsn
    )

})

output$meansd2 <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())

    meanSdPlot(
        vsnData()$vsn,
        ranks = FALSE
    )

})

output$histogram <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())

    hist(
        as.numeric(vsnData()$vsn),
        breaks = 60,
        main = "Distribution of VSN values",
        xlab = "VSN"
    )

})

output$vsnbox <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())

    boxplot(
        vsnData()$vsn,
        las = 2,
        outline = FALSE,
        main = "VSN Normalized Intensities",
        ylab = "VSN"
    )

})

output$regression <- renderPlot({

    req(vsnData())
    req(input$sample)

    idx <- match(
        input$sample,
        colnames(vsnData()$raw)
    )

    validate(
        need(!is.na(idx), "Please choose a sample.")
    )

    x <- log2(vsnData()$raw[, idx])
    y <- vsnData()$vsn[, idx]

    keep <- complete.cases(x, y)

    x <- x[keep]
    y <- y[keep]

    validate(
        need(length(x) > 5, "Not enough valid observations.")
    )

    fit <- lm(y ~ x)

    s <- summary(fit)

    plot(
        x,
        y,
        pch = 19,
        cex = 0.5,
        xlab = colnames(vsnData()$raw)[idx],
        ylab = colnames(vsnData()$vsn)[idx],
        main = paste("VSN vs log2:", input$sample)
    )

    abline(
        fit,
        col = "blue",
        lwd = 2
    )

    legend(
        "topleft",
        bty = "n",
        legend = c(
            paste0("R² = ", round(s$r.squared, 4)),
            paste0("Intercept = ", round(coef(fit)[1], 4)),
            paste0("Slope = ", round(coef(fit)[2], 4))
        )
    )

})

output$table <- DT::renderDataTable({

    req(vsnData())

    DT::datatable(

        vsnData()$export,

        extensions = c("Buttons"),

        options = list(

            pageLength = 20,

            scrollX = TRUE,

            dom = "Blfrtip",

            buttons = c(
                "copy",
                "csv",
                "excel"
            )

        ),

        rownames = FALSE

    )

})

```
